channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Ameaça de possível membro de facção motivou Renan Santos a antecipar candidatura
item.description: Presidential candidate Renan Santos of the Missão party moved up his online convention to July 20, citing threats from Ceará-based criminal factions, including the Massa Carcerária (TDN), after releasing a video denouncing organized crime in Fortaleza. He stated the early announcement was necessary to secure Federal Police protection, as private security is costly and survival is now at stake. Santos also cited threats from the PCC and Comando Vermelho, and his team confirmed the threatening Telegram message was forwarded to the PF, which has since provided him with an escort.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz ter esperança de receber apoio da federação formada por União Brasil e PP
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) said he hopes to receive support from the União Progressista federation (União Brasil and Progressistas) for his 2026 presidential bid, after attending the federation's state convention in São Paulo. He noted there is still time to discuss alliances and reiterated his opposition to four more years of PT rule, while federation leaders indicated a tendency toward neutrality, leaving the decision to state directories.

item.title: Entenda o que muda com os decretos de Lula para as big techs
item.description: Decrees No. 12.975 and 12.976 of 2026 amend the Brazilian Civil Rights Framework for the Internet, requiring big techs to maintain a local legal representative and headquarters, implement a duty of care to prevent systemic spread of illicit content, establish permanent reporting channels, and monitor systemic risks. The ANPD will enforce compliance, including content removal with contextual analysis and protection of free expression, without liability for isolated incidents.

item.title: Com presença de Lula, PDT realiza convenção e oficializa apoio
item.description: The PDT officially endorsed Lula's re-election bid at its national convention in Brasília, where the president was present. The party emphasized the importance of its long-standing alliance with the PT and announced Senate and gubernatorial candidates for 2026, reflecting an early electoral strategy.

item.title: Carlos Lupi: Trump é o grande mal da sociedade moderna e Lula pode ser a antítese
item.description: PDT president Carlos Lupi stated that Donald Trump is the great evil of modern society and that Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva could be his global antithesis. The remark was made on Monday, the 20th, criticizing the former U.S. president and praising the Brazilian leader.

item.title: Salles: Eduardo e Michelle seriam candidatos melhores do que Flávio
item.description: Ricardo Salles, Novo party candidate for the Senate in São Paulo, stated in a UOL Canal interview that Eduardo and Michelle Bolsonaro would be stronger candidates than Flávio Bolsonaro to represent Bolsonarism in the 2026 presidential race. He argued they possess greater electoral potential and mobilization capacity among the base.

item.title: Lula critica gestão Bolsonaro e chama ex-ministros da Saúde de “mequetrefes”
item.description: President Lula criticized the Bolsonaro government by calling three former health ministers 'mequetrefes,' despite the previous administration having had four health ministers. He praised current Health Minister Alexandre Padilha and highlighted the signing of the legal framework for the Health Economic-Industrial Complex. In concluding his speech, Lula made a verbal slip, confusing health with education by stating the country had made a 'revolution in education'.

item.title: Copa de 2026 tem oscilações no consumo mais intensas do que em 2022
item.description: During the 2026 World Cup, fluctuations in Brazil’s electric system load were more intense than in 2022, reaching up to 21% below reference levels during the Brazil vs. Japan match. The ONS reported that generation curtailment of solar and wind power was required to balance supply and demand, without interrupting electricity supply to consumers.

item.title: Lula recebe apoio do PDT, critica EUA e diz que 'política apodreceu'
item.description: Lula received the PDT's official endorsement for his 2026 re-election campaign during a national convention in Brasília. He criticized the current state of Brazilian politics, stating that 'politics has rotted' and expressed nostalgia for the era of Leonel Brizola, the party's founder. He also criticized the United States, though without specific details in the provided excerpt.

item.title: Lula desafia Marco Rubio a montar comitê eleitoral para Flávio no Brasil: ‘Vamos derrotar todos’
item.description: President Lula challenged U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio to come to Brazil and support Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 presidential elections, saying they will 'defeat everyone' in defense of democracy. The remark was made during a PDT event announcing the party's support for Lula's reelection. Lula and Rubio have exchanged criticisms over U.S. tariffs and the U.S. designation of Brazilian criminal groups as terrorist organizations.

item.title: Comunicação do Planalto: o impacto político dos lapsos em pronunciamentos presidenciais
item.description: President Lula made a verbal slip during an official ceremony by confusing health policies with education initiatives, sparking debate over the frequency of such errors in his improvised speeches. The incident raised concerns about the accuracy of Planalto's communication and its potential political impact on the president's image.

item.title: Nunes Marques será relator no TSE de representação sobre suposta rede de perfis contra Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques has been appointed rapporteur of a Liberal Party representation alleging a network of over 20,000 Meta-funded social media profiles attacking Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and allies like Tarcísio de Freitas and Jorginho Mello. The Bolsonaro campaign claims the profiles were detected during paid ad monitoring and demands investigation, removal, and data disclosure to uncover those behind the scheme. Though under judicial secrecy, Nunes Marques pledged a swift ruling due to the ephemeral nature of the profiles.

item.title: Lula diz que se Marco Rubio quiser apoiar candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro 'que venha': 'vamos derrotar todos'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) stated that if U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio wishes to support Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy, he should come and form a committee, as Brazil will defeat all adversaries in defense of democracy. Lula labeled Bolsonaro allies as 'traitors of the homeland' and stressed that there is no right to lose the 2026 elections, emphasizing the need to prevent the return of denialism and fascism in the country.

item.title: Zema diz que escolha do vice será feita até a data limite
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's pre-candidate for President, stated that the choice of his running mate will be finalized by August 5, the deadline for party conventions. He emphasized seeking a candidate with a clean record, criticized 'dirty politics,' and noted that negotiations with other parties are ongoing, with no decision yet made.

item.title: Pré-candidato a governador, Kalil falta à convenção do PDT com Lula
item.description: Alexandre Kalil, pre-candidate for governor of Minas Gerais from the PDT, was absent from the party's national convention in Brasília, where Lula's re-election support was officially endorsed. His absence follows a political distancing from Lula after his 2022 defeat to Romeu Zema. Despite PT efforts to form an alliance, Kalil maintains an independent candidacy for 2026.

item.title: Lula desafia Rubio a montar comitê no Brasil para apoiar Flávio: 'Que venha, vamos derrotar todos'
item.description: Lula received the PDT's support for his 2026 reelection bid at a national convention, where he challenged U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio to back Flávio Bolsonaro, declaring he would defeat any opposition in defense of democracy and national sovereignty. He also criticized U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods and invoked Leonel Brizola as a symbol of decency and patriotism in Brazilian politics.

item.title: TSE recebe pesquisadores do ITS Rio para visita ao Museu do Voto
item.description: The TSE received researchers from ITS Rio for a visit to the Vote Museum, where they learned about the history of Brazilian elections, the functioning of electronic voting machines, and the Electoral Justice's actions against disinformation. The program included a welcome video by Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, a presentation on Brazil's electoral trajectory, a hands-on voting simulation, and a technical explanation of urn security by Rafael Azevedo.

item.title: Bolsonaro recorre de proibição das visitas de Flávio por 90 dias
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro's defense filed an appeal at the STF against a 90-day ban on visits from his son, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, arguing the measure is disproportionate and violates the right to family visits. The ban was imposed by Minister Alexandre de Moraes after Flávio published a letter from Bolsonaro endorsing his presidential bid. The defense claims Bolsonaro was unaware of the intent to publish the letter and cites prior similar incidents without sanctions.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula participa da convenção nacional do PDT
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva attended the PDT's national convention in Brasília, where the party officially announced its support for his re-election bid in the 2026 elections. This marks the first of the party conventions, which run from July 20 to August 5 and may be held in-person, virtual, or hybrid formats. The event is being streamed live.

item.title: Esquerda critica concessão de 'green card' a Eduardo Bolsonaro pelos EUA: 'Pagamento pela traição'
item.description: Left-wing politicians criticized the U.S. granting of a green card to Eduardo Bolsonaro, calling it a 'payment for betrayal' and a 'reward for selling out'. The permanent residency permit comes amid trade tensions between Brazil and the U.S. following Trump's tariffs on Brazilian goods. Eduardo Bolsonaro said he feels safe in the U.S., citing persecution in Brazil after his STF conviction for pressuring judges and seeking U.S. sanctions against the Brazilian judiciary.

item.title: Com Lula, PDT oficializa apoio à reeleição do petista em convenção
item.description: The PDT officially endorsed Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's (PT) re-election bid at its national convention in Brasília, emphasizing coherence with the popular and democratic field. Lula, present at the event, expressed his motivation for the campaign and warned against the return of denialism and fascism to power. The decision marks the PDT's return to the presidential alliance led by the PT after fielding its own candidates in 2018 and 2022.

item.title: PP confirma candidatura de Derrite ao Senado por São Paulo
item.description: Federal Deputy Guilherme Derrite (PP) had his Senate candidacy for São Paulo confirmed at an event in the São Paulo Legislative Assembly, organized by the União Progressista federation (PP and União Brasil). The event was attended by Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), who is a pre-candidate for President of the Republic.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro se reúne com aliados no Guarujá e sobrevoa região
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro met with allies in Guarujá, flew over the Baixada Santista, and recorded campaign materials focused on combating organized crime. The event took place on July 20, 2026, emphasizing public security initiatives.

item.title: PDT é o primeiro partido a oficializar o apoio à reeleição de Lula em convenção
item.description: The PDT officially endorsed President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s (PT) re-election bid at its national convention, becoming the first party to do so for the 2026 election. Lula called for a return to decency in Brazilian politics and challenged U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio to campaign for his opponent, Flávio Bolsonaro. Senator Weverton Rocha (PDT-MA) emphasized the endorsement is both political and strategic, stating the PDT retains its own agenda and hopes the PT will later support its priorities.

item.title: Em convenção, PDT, de Carlos Lupi, oficializa apoio à pré-candidatura de Lula à reeleição
item.description: The PDT officially endorsed Lula's re-election bid at its national convention in Brasília, approved unanimously, with Carlos Lupi emphasizing the party's historical reunion with the president. The endorsement anticipates the decision not to field a own candidate following Ciro Gomes' move to the PSDB, positioning the PDT as the first party to formally support Lula's campaign.

item.title: Lula sanciona lei do Complexo Econômico-Industrial da Saúde
item.description: President Lula signed into law the National Health Strategy of the Economic-Industrial Health Complex, aiming to reduce import dependence by promoting local production of medicines, active pharmaceutical ingredients, and medical equipment. The law amends procurement and health legislation, establishes criteria for strategic health companies, and provides tax incentives, BNDES financing, and preference margins in public purchases—provided they meet at least 30% of SUS demand. The law was signed with three presidential vetoes and awaits regulation via a Ministry of Health decree.

item.title: Lindbergh sobre Eduardo Bolsonaro: "Traidor da pátria com green card"
item.description: Congressman Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) accused former congressman Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP) of being a "traitor of the homeland" for receiving a U.S. green card, claiming it was a reward for advocating sanctions against Brazilian officials and supporting U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods. He argued that the green card granted to Eduardo, his wife, and children reflects a pattern of favoritism for serving U.S. interests, questioning whether Bolsonaro will next seek U.S. citizenship.

item.title: Iniciativa do TSE pela integridade das Eleições 2026 é adotada pelo TRE-MG
item.description: The TRE-MG adopted the TSE’s initiative to strengthen the integrity of the 2026 elections by signing the Pacto Mineiro pela Integridade nas Eleições with 19 political parties and one federation, aligned with the national commitment to combat disinformation, promote responsible AI use, citizen participation, inclusion, and electoral trust. On July 16–17, the TRE-MG conducted training sessions for party representatives, pre-candidates, lawyers, accountants, and others on candidacy registration and financial reporting using the CANDex and Conta+ JE systems, clarifying procedures, legislation, and new features for the upcoming elections.

item.title: Weverton: PDT toma decisão estratégica de apoiar Lula e não abrirá mão de seus projetos
item.description: Senator Weverton Rocha (PDT-MA) stated that the PDT's decision to support Lula's reelection is political and strategic, while maintaining the party's own projects for Brazil. He emphasized that the PDT will continue working on its national project and dreams of seeing the PT support this initiative.

item.title: Tempo de TV: Flávio depende de apoio do Centrão para não ficar atrás de Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro needs to attract Centrão parties like Republicans and Podemos to secure more TV and radio ad time than Lula in 2026. Without them, Lula leads with 5 minutes 34 seconds per block versus Flávio’s 4 minutes 18 seconds. Only four pre-candidates would qualify for free airtime: Lula, Flávio, Ronaldo Caiado, and Augusto Cury.

item.title: Relator da CPI do Crime Organizado chama decisão da PGR de ‘tentativa de intimidação’
item.description: Senator Alessandro Vieira (MDB-SE) described the Prosecutor General's Office dispatch, which forwarded a representation by Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes to Sergipe's Electoral Prosecutor's Office, as an absurd and illegal attempt at intimidation. Vieira said the representation stems from his report in the Organized Crime CPI, which proposed indicting Mendes, Toffoli, Moraes, and Gonet for responsibility crime, although the PGR dismissed the abuse of authority charge and retained only the possibility of an electoral offense.

item.title: Vieira: decisão da PGR sobre ação de Gilmar é tentativa de intimidação
item.description: Former rapporteur of the Organized Crime CPI, Alessandro Vieira (MDB-SE), called the PGR's decision an 'absurd and illegal' attempt at intimidation, arguing that the office overstepped by reviewing the CPI's request to indict Supreme Court ministers Gilmar Mendes, Dias Toffoli, and Alexandre de Moraes for responsibility crimes in the Master Case. Vieira claimed the PGR reframed the issue as a potential electoral offense to avoid addressing abuse of authority, and reaffirmed his commitment to equal justice despite the risks of challenging powerful figures in Brasília.

item.title: Dino manda resposta de Valdemar sobre emendas para a PF
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered that responses from PL president Valdemar Costa Neto and PSD president Gilberto Kassab regarding their involvement in parliamentary amendments be sent to the Federal Police, amid suspicions of irregular resource allocation by party leaders without congressional mandates. Valdemar’s defense stated his role is limited to gathering municipal demands and suggesting amendments, without influencing parliamentary decisions, and denied the legal existence of a 'party president’s amendment' as a category.

item.title: Nobel de Economia critica tarifaço dos EUA sobre o Brasil
item.description: Nobel laureate economist Paul Krugman criticized the U.S. 25% tariff on Brazil as an unjust punishment for the Pix payment system, which he defends as comparable to requiring U.S. banks to accept dollar bills. He argues the tariff, based on Section 301 of the 1974 Trade Act, will fail and may politically strengthen President Lula.

item.title: PL pede que TSE investigue suposta rede de impulsionamento em massa criada para atacar Flávio
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) has asked the TSE to investigate an alleged mass content boosting network involving nearly 20,000 fake profiles that reportedly spent up to R$3 million on negative content targeting pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and allies, including the governors of São Paulo and Santa Catarina. The PL seeks court-ordered disclosure from Meta to identify sponsors and administrators, describing the operation as a possible digital criminal organization that erased digital traces after posting, which violates electoral rules prohibiting boosted negative campaigning.

item.title: Após processo de 'Bob Esponja' contra 'Lula Molusco', TJ-MS diz que apura irregularidades
item.description: The TJMS is investigating the public exposure of test proceedings containing fictitious references to 'Lula Molusco' and 'SpongeBob SquarePants', used in internal training between 2006 and 2018. State deputy Gleice Jane (PT) denounced the leak, which included terms like 'Lula Petralha' linked to crimes such as drug trafficking, although the court stated the data had no legal effect. The case was referred to the CNJ and MPMS, and the TJMS removed the proceedings from public access following the backlash.

item.title: PL pede investigação contra “rede” de 20 mil perfis falsos contra Flávio
item.description: The PL filed a complaint with the TSE alleging a network of 20,000 fake profiles on Meta platforms was used to amplify negative propaganda against Flávio Bolsonaro, Tarcísio de Freitas, and Cleitinho Azevedo. The party claims the boosts were paid in reais, Colombian pesos, and dollars, using fake CPFs and deleted accounts to avoid traces, characterizing it as a criminal organization targeting the right. The PL requests the TSE to authorize an urgent investigation to identify funders and remove the profiles.

item.title: Patrus Ananias confirma que disputará o Governo de MG em chapa de apoio a Lula
item.description: Patrus Ananias, federal deputy, former minister and former mayor of Belo Horizonte, confirmed he will run for Governor of Minas Gerais in 2026 as part of the political coalition supporting President Lula (PT). His candidacy formalizes the federal government's backing of the PT in the state.

item.title: Sudeste perde eleitores, mas segue como maior colégio eleitoral
item.description: The Southeast remains Brazil's largest electoral college with 66.3 million voters, despite losing 378,090 since 2022. The Northeast grew to 43.5 million voters, while the national total reached 158.7 million, with strong growth in the North (4.37%) and abroad (31.82%). São Paulo leads the states with 34.1 million voters, followed by Minas Gerais and Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: PL diz ao TSE ter identificado 57 perfis falsos em campanha contra Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The leadership of the PL party claims to have identified 57 fake profiles on Meta's social media platforms used to boost content opposing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, and has asked the TSE to investigate what it believes is a criminal scheme. The party requests action to counter what it describes as electoral disinformation targeting its candidate.

item.title: PT coloca ex-aliado de Jair Bolsonaro em chapa de Lula em Pernambuco
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) in Pernambuco confirmed Senator Humberto Costa's re-election bid and named federal deputy Luciano Bivar, a former Bolsonaro ally and ex-president of PSL and União Brasil, as his first substitute. Bivar, now affiliated with MDB, retains right-wing ideals and was selected in a meeting on Saturday, the 18th, to join the ticket supporting João Campos (PSB) for governor against incumbent Raquel Lyra (PSD). The move complicates Campos’ effort to portray himself as the sole Lula-aligned candidate, given his past support from PL figures.

item.title: Substituição do Bolsa Família, fim das cotas e mudanças na Lei Rouanet: as propostas de Renan Santos
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential candidate, proposes replacing Bolsa Família with the Frentes Cidadãs program, ending racial quotas, merging the Culture and Education ministries, implementing fiscal adjustment through de-indexation of benefits from the minimum wage, reforming the Lei Rouanet, and hardening security policy with supermax prisons and 'Enemy Criminal Law'. The document also harshly criticizes Bolsonarism, labeling Jair Bolsonaro's government as a 'lamentable episode'.

item.title: Federação com PT, PV e PCdoB lança Humberto Costa ao Senado por PE
item.description: The Hope Brazil Federation (PT, PV, and PCdoB) launched Humberto Costa (PT) as its Senate candidate for Pernambuco in the 2026 elections during a convention in Recife. The ticket includes Marília Arraes (PDT) as a Senate candidate and Carlos Costa (Republicanos) as the vice-gubernatorial candidate, while supporting João Campos (PSB) for governor. The parties also announced proportional candidacies for state and federal deputies.

item.title: Marinho: recusa de Flávio à escolta da PF foi estratégia da campanha
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), coordinator of Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) presidential campaign, stated that the pre-candidate’s decision to decline Federal Police escort was a strategic campaign move, not a lack of confidence in the institution. Marinho noted that certain aspects of the case still need clarification, without specifying them. The statement followed the PL’s filing with the TSE requesting an investigation into an alleged ‘criminal digital network’ that allegedly spent R$ 200,000 on ads against Flávio via profiles with around 30 followers.

item.title: Vice de Flávio só será anunciado após convenção, diz Rogério Marinho
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN) stated that the vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) ticket will not be announced until after the PL convention on July 25, as the decision hinges on ongoing negotiations with allied parties, particularly the Republicans. He criticized restrictions on Bolsonaro's political contact, comparing them to the treatment of Lula in 2018, and said the PL aims to double its number of state-level electoral slates compared to 2022.

item.title: Lula parabeniza Andy Burnham, novo primeiro-ministro do Reino Unido
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva congratulated Andy Burnham on his official appointment as the new Prime Minister of the United Kingdom, emphasizing the over 200-year diplomatic relationship between Brazil and the UK and expressing intent to strengthen bilateral cooperation on democracy, multilateralism, and sustainable development.

item.title: Renan Santos se diz 'lisonjeado' após ser citado por Ciro Gomes como opção à Presidência
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate for the Missão party, said he felt honored and energized after Ciro Gomes (PSDB) mentioned him as a potential supporter in the 2026 presidential race. Ciro, who is running for governor of Ceará, stated he is considering backing Renan in the presidential election.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro contesta proibição a visitas de Flávio
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro filed a petition with the Supreme Federal Court (STF) against Justice Alexandre de Moraes' decision to ban Senator Flávio Bolsonaro from visiting the former president for 90 days, following the release of a letter written by Bolsonaro. The request seeks to overturn the precautionary measure imposed by the justice.

item.title: Saiba quantos eleitores estão aptos a votar na sua cidade
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) announced that Brazil will have 158,745,463 eligible voters for the 2026 elections, a historic record. The first round will be held on October 4, with a potential second round on October 25. São Paulo leads with 9.1 million voters, followed by Rio de Janeiro (5.0 million) and Brasília (2.3 million), while the state of São Paulo has the largest electoral college in the country with 34.1 million voters.

item.title: O apelo de Jair Bolsonaro a Moraes para voltar a receber visitas de Flávio
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro appealed to Minister Alexandre de Moraes of the STF to overturn the 90-day suspension of visits by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, arguing the measure violates the right to legal defense and family interaction, and exceeds the principles of necessity, adequacy, and proportionality.
